INSERT INTO T_BLDINF_TRAN ( SERIAL, CGM_SEQ, CGM_DTM, INIT_VALUE, UPT_VALUE, TREND_RATE, TREND, ERROR_CODE, USER_UUID ) VALUES
(#{item.serialNumber}, #{item.seqNumber}, CONVERT_TZ( STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{item.eventAt}, '+', 1), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'), '+00:00', '+09:00' ), #{item.initialValue}, #{item.value}, #{item.trendRate}, #{item.trend}, #{item.errorCode}, #{item.userUuid})
mapper.select: SELECT ACC_TOKEN ,USER_UUID FROM T_BLDCON_MST WHERE ISENS_ID = #{userId}

WITH COMM AS ( SELECT CGM_DTM ,UPT_VALUE FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN WHERE USER_UUID = #{userId} AND CAST(CGM_DTM AS DATETIME) BETWEEN CAST(#{start} AS DATETIME) AND CAST(#{end} AS DATETIME) ) SELECT CGM_DTM AS DTM ,UPT_VALUE AS UPT ,(SELECT AVG(UPT_VALUE) FROM COMM) AS AVG_UPT FROM COMM ORDER BY CGM_DTM DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT AVG(a.UPT_VALUE) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND DATE(a.CGM_DTM) = DATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AND TIME(DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) BETWEEN '03:00:00' AND COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(TIME(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'))) FROM T_FOOD_TRAN b WHERE b.USER_UUID = a.USER_UUID AND b.EAT_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y%m%d') AND TIME(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')) BETWEEN '03:00:00' AND '06:00:00') , '06:00:00' )

SELECT UPT_VALUE as UPT , CGM_DTM as DTM , DATE_FORMAT(CGM_DTM, '%H:%i') as HM FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN WHERE USER_UUID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(CAST(UPT_VALUE AS UNSIGNED),0) > 0 AND DATE(CGM_DTM) = #{end} ORDER BY CGM_DTM ASC

SELECT dtm , eatType , hh , REPLACE(GROUP_CONCAT(foodNm), ',' , '\r\n' ) AS foodNm FROM ( SELECT FOOD_SEQ as foodSeq, RTRIM(FOOD_NAME) as foodNm, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(EAT_DATE, EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as dtm, CAST(LEFT(EAT_STIME, 2) AS UNSIGNED) as hh, CASE WHEN HOUR(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(EAT_DATE, EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')) < 11 THEN '0' WHEN HOUR(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(EAT_DATE, EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')) < 16 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END as eatType FROM T_FOOD_TRAN WHERE USER_UUID = #{userId} AND EAT_DATE = REPLACE(#{end}, '-', '') AND FOOD_NAME <> '음식아님' ORDER BY FOOD_SEQ ) K GROUP BY dtm , eatType , hh

WITH COMM AS ( SELECT * FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN WHERE USER_UUID = #{userId} AND ifnull(UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 AND CGM_DTM BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{start}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{end}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') )SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE > 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ,0) AS HIGHTEST ,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE > 180 AND UPT_VALUE <= 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS HIGHT ,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE >= 70 AND UPT_VALUE <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS NORMAL ,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE >= 54 AND UPT_VALUE < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LOW ,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE < 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS LOWEST FROM COMM

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(UPT_VALUE),0) AS AvgBlood ,COALESCE(ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(UPT_VALUE), 1),0) AS stdBlood ,COALESCE(ROUND((STDDEV_SAMP(UPT_VALUE) / AVG(UPT_VALUE)) * 100, 1),0) AS CV /* ★★[2026-08-18] TIR·TAR·TBR 을 **여기서 함께 낸다** — 앱(BloodLowHigh·showBloodAvgData)과 같은 식. ⚠종전 웹은 구간 카운트(LOWEST/LOW/NORMAL/HIGHT/HIGHTEST)를 따로 조회해 화면에서 비율을 냈다. ***쿼리가 둘이면 기간·0값 필터가 갈라진다*** — 실제로 앱 95% / 웹 96% 로 어긋났다. ★같은 WHERE(기간·UPT_VALUE>0)를 그대로 쓰므로 정의가 저절로 일치한다. ★TIR 은 앱과 같이 **버림(FLOOR)**, TAR·TBR 은 소수 1자리. */ ,COALESCE(FLOOR(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE BETWEEN 70 AND 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)), 0) AS TIR ,COALESCE(ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1), 0) AS TAR ,COALESCE(ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1), 0) AS TBR ,COALESCE(ROUND((0.02392 * AVG(UPT_VALUE)) + 3.31, 1),0) AS GMI ,(SELECT COALESCE(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE),0) FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} /* ⚠★[2026-08-18] ***바깥 WHERE 만 고치고 이 서브쿼리를 빠뜨려*** 공복평균만 어긋났었다 (웹 101 / 앱 104). 기간 조건은 **바깥과 글자까지 같아야 한다.** */ AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND a.UPT_VALUE > 0 /* ★[2026-08-18 확정] 공복평균 = ***새벽 03~05시 평균***. 종전에는 03시부터 <그날 첫 식사시각(없으면 06시)>까지였다 — ***식사 기록에 좌우돼*** 기록이 없는 환자는 03~06시가 되고, 이른 식사가 있으면 창이 확 줄었다. ⇒ 식사 기록과 무관한 고정 시간대로 바꾼다(같은 기간이면 늘 같은 규칙). */ /* ★경계도 앱과 같게 — 03:00 포함 ~ **05:00 미포함**(BETWEEN 은 05:00 정각을 포함해 버린다) */ AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) >= '03:00:00' AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) < '05:00:00' ) AS FASTING FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN WHERE USER_UUID = #{userId} AND UPT_VALUE > 0 /* ★앱(showBloodAvgData)과 같게 — 0 값이 평균을 끌어내렸다 */ /* ★★[2026-08-18] ***종료일 하루가 통째로 빠지고 있었다.*** 화면은 `2026-08-18` 처럼 **날짜만** 보내는데 조건이 `<= STR_TO_DATE(end,'…T%H:%i:%s')`, 즉 `2026-08-18 00:00:00` 이라 그날 자료가 사실상 제외됐다(7일을 골라도 6일치). ⇒ 앱과 같은 방식(`시작일 00:00` ~ `종료일+1일` 미만)으로 맞춘다. ★`REPLACE(...,'T',' ')` 는 ISO 문자열(2026-08-18T00:00:00)로 부르는 곳까지 함께 받아 준다. */ AND CGM_DTM >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND CGM_DTM < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY

/* ★★[2026-08-18 확정] ***앱(getAvgFasting)과 같은 방식으로 통일***. ⚠종전 웹 방식 : 아침(<11시)·점심(11~16)·저녁(>=16) **세 버킷**으로 나눠 하루 평균을 내고, 그 하루 평균들을 다시 기간 평균했다. 하루 3끼면 앱과 같지만 ***간식·4끼 이상이면 한 끼가 버킷에 묻혀 값이 갈렸다***(웹 126 / 앱 125). ⇒ 앱과 같이 **끼니마다 [식사+2h, +3h) 의 첫 측정**을 잡아 그 값들을 평균한다. 버킷도, 하루 평균도 두지 않는다 — 끼니 수에 흔들리지 않는다. ★기간·0값 필터는 calcBlood 와 같은 규칙(종료일 포함). */ SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(v.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM ( SELECT a.UPT_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.meal_ts ORDER BY a.CGM_DTM ASC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS meal_ts FROM T_FOOD_TRAN b WHERE b.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) m JOIN T_BLDINF_TRAN a ON a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.UPT_VALUE > 0 AND a.CGM_DTM >= m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AND a.CGM_DTM < m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 3 HOUR ) v WHERE v.rn = 1

select ROUND(AVG(IFNULL(ROUND ( (ifnull(breakfast,0) + ifnull(lunch,0) + ifnull(dinner,0)) / (3 - (IF(ifnull(breakfast,0) = 0,1,0) + IF(ifnull(lunch,0) = 0,1,0) + IF(ifnull(dinner,0) = 0,1,0) )) ,.1),0)) ,.1) as avgFASTING from ( select USER_UUID , date , case when breakfast is not null then (select UPT_VALUE from T_BLDINF_TRAN where USER_UUID = k.USER_UUID and cgm_dtm = k.breakfast) end breakfast , case when lunch is not null then (select UPT_VALUE from T_BLDINF_TRAN where USER_UUID = k.USER_UUID and cgm_dtm = k.lunch) end lunch , case when dinner is not null then (select UPT_VALUE from T_BLDINF_TRAN where USER_UUID = k.USER_UUID and cgm_dtm = k.dinner) end dinner from ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.EAT_DATE, '%c/%e') AS date , a.USER_UUID , Max(case when date(b.EAT_DATETIME) = DATE(a.cgm_dtm) AND b.EAT_DATETIME >= a.cgm_dtm AND HOUR(b.EAT_DATETIME) < 11 THEN a.cgm_dtm END) breakfast , Max(case when date(b.EAT_DATETIME) = DATE(a.cgm_dtm) AND b.EAT_DATETIME >= a.cgm_dtm AND HOUR(b.EAT_DATETIME) >= 11 AND HOUR(b.EAT_DATETIME) < 16 THEN a.cgm_dtm END) lunch , Max(case when date(b.EAT_DATETIME) = DATE(a.cgm_dtm) AND b.EAT_DATETIME >= a.cgm_dtm AND HOUR(b.EAT_DATETIME) >= 16 THEN a.cgm_dtm END) dinner FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a , (SELECT USER_UUID , STR_TO_DATE(EAT_DATE, '%Y%m%d') as EAT_DATE , STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(EAT_DATE, EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS EAT_DATETIME FROM T_FOOD_TRAN GROUP BY USER_UUID , EAT_DATE , EAT_STIME) b WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND b.USER_UUID = a.USER_UUID AND b.EAT_DATE >= DATE(#{start}) AND b.EAT_DATE <= DATE(#{end}) Group by DATE_FORMAT(b.EAT_DATE, '%c/%e') ) k ) l
SELECT count(*) FROM T_BLDCON_MST WHERE USER_UUID = #{userUuid}
SELECT REF_TOKEN FROM T_BLDCON_MST WHERE USER_UUID = #{userUuid}

SELECT CGM_DTM, CONCAT( IF(DATE_FORMAT(CGM_DTM, '%p') = 'AM', '오전', '오후'), ' ', DATE_FORMAT(CGM_DTM, '%h:%i')) AS formatedDate ,UPT_VALUE FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN WHERE USER_UUID = #{userUuid} AND DATE(CGM_DTM) = CURDATE() ORDER BY CGM_DTM DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT SUBSTRING(a.CGM_DTM,1,10) AS date2, DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%c/%e') AS date, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE),1),0) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 AND DATE(a.CGM_DTM) = ( SELECT MAX(DATE(b.CGM_DTM)) FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN b WHERE b.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(b.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 ) GROUP BY date2, date

/* ★★[2026-08-18 확정] ***여기만 90~150분이었다*** — 나머지(웹 기간·앱 기간·앱 24시간·앱 오늘)는 모두 [식사+2h, +3h) 다. 사용자 지시로 **120~180분**으로 맞춘다. ★계산 방식도 같이 통일 : 창 안의 값을 모두 평균하던 것을 ***끼니마다 첫 측정 하나***를 잡아 평균하는 방식으로(다른 네 곳과 동일). ⚠종전 `TIME(...) BETWEEN` 비교는 **자정을 넘는 끼니**(밤 10시 식사 → 다음날 0~1시)를 놓쳤다. 시각(TIME)이 아니라 **시점(DATETIME)** 으로 비교한다. */ SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(v.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM ( SELECT a.UPT_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.meal_ts ORDER BY a.CGM_DTM ASC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS meal_ts FROM T_FOOD_TRAN b WHERE b.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND b.EAT_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') ) m JOIN T_BLDINF_TRAN a ON a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.UPT_VALUE > 0 AND a.CGM_DTM >= m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AND a.CGM_DTM < m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 3 HOUR ) v WHERE v.rn = 1

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND DATE(a.CGM_DTM) = CURDATE() AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) >= '03:00:00' /* ★[2026-08-18 확정] 03~05시 — 기간 화면(calcBlood)·앱과 같은 창으로 맞춘다 */ AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) < '05:00:00' AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND DATE(a.CGM_DTM) = CURDATE() AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%c/%e') AS date, SUBSTRING(a.CGM_DTM,1,10) AS date2, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(#{start}) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{end}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and ifnull(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 group by date, date2 order by date2

SELECT ROUND(AVG(UPT_VALUE),.1) UPT_VALUE , DATE_FORMAT(CGM_DTM,'%y%m%d') CGM_DTM , SUBSTR(CGM_DTM,11,3) CGM_TM FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(#{start}) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{end}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ifnull(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CGM_DTM,'%y%m%d') , SUBSTR(CGM_DTM,11,3) Order by CGM_DTM , CGM_TM asc

SELECT A.CGM_DTM , A.AVG_VALUE , A.MAX_VALUE , A.MIN_VALUE as MIN_VALUE , (SELECT ROUND(AVG(B.UPT_VALUE),.1) AS AVG_VALUE FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN B WHERE B.USER_UUID = A.USER_UUID AND DATE(B.CGM_DTM) >= DATE(#{start}) AND DATE(B.CGM_DTM) <= DATE(#{end})+'23:59:59' AND IFNULL(B.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 AND A.CGM_DTM = SUBSTR(B.CGM_DTM,12,2) AND A.AVG_VALUE < B.UPT_VALUE ) AVGM_VALUE ,(SELECT ROUND(AVG(C.UPT_VALUE),.1) AS AVG_VALUE FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN C WHERE C.USER_UUID = A.USER_UUID AND DATE(C.CGM_DTM) >= DATE(#{start}) AND DATE(C.CGM_DTM) <= DATE(#{end})+'23:59:59' AND IFNULL(C.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 AND A.CGM_DTM = SUBSTR(C.CGM_DTM,12,2) AND A.AVG_VALUE > C.UPT_VALUE ) AVGL_VALUE FROM ( SELECT A.USER_UUID , SUBSTR(A.CGM_DTM,12,2) AS CGM_DTM , ROUND(AVG(A.UPT_VALUE),.1) AS AVG_VALUE , MAX(IFNULL(CAST(A.UPT_VALUE AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS MAX_VALUE , MIN(IFNULL(CAST(A.UPT_VALUE AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS MIN_VALUE FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN A WHERE A.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND A.CGM_DTM >= DATE(#{start}) AND A.CGM_DTM < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{end}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND IFNULL(A.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 GROUP BY SUBSTR(A.CGM_DTM,12,2) , A.USER_UUID ORDER BY SUBSTR(A.CGM_DTM,12,2) ) A

/* ★★[2026-08-21] 공복·식후 정의를 확정 기준(2026-08-18 : calcBlood·mealAvg·getTodayFastBlood·getTodayMealBlood)과 통일. ⚠종전 : 아침(<11시)·점심(11~16)·저녁(>=16) 세 버킷 — 공복 = 식전 마지막 측정(MAX), 식후 = 식사−2h 이후 첫 측정(MIN). 식후 조건이 식사 **전** 2시간부터 잡혀 공복과 뒤섞였고(사용자 실측 : 공복이 식후보다 높은 날 다수), 식사 기록이 없는 날은 공복까지 빈 값이었다. 세 차트(일별·개요·통계)가 이 쿼리들을 쓴다. ⇒ 공복 = 그날 03:00 이상 ~ 05:00 미만 평균 · 식후 = 끼니마다 [식사+2h, +3h) 첫 측정을 식사일로 평균. ★세 쿼리 모두 「측정이 있는 날짜 목록」 위에 LEFT JOIN — 화면(일주일 차트)이 세 응답을 **위치**로 맞추므로 날짜 수가 서로 달라지면 요일이 어긋난다. 값 없는 날은 0(화면이 0 을 빈 점으로 처리). 열 이름은 화면 호환을 위해 그대로. 기간은 calcBlood 와 같이 **종료일 포함**. */ SELECT d.date, d.date2, d.avgBlood, IFNULL(p.avgpost, 0) AS avgpost, IFNULL(f.avgfasting, 0) AS avgfasting FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%c/%e') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date2, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 GROUP BY date, date2 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date2, ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1) AS avgfasting FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) >= '03:00:00' AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) < '05:00:00' GROUP BY date2 ) f ON f.date2 = d.date2 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.date2, ROUND(AVG(v.UPT_VALUE), 1) AS avgpost FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.meal_ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date2, a.UPT_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.meal_ts ORDER BY a.CGM_DTM ASC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS meal_ts FROM T_FOOD_TRAN b WHERE b.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND b.EAT_DATE >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')), '%Y%m%d') AND b.EAT_DATE <= DATE_FORMAT(DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')), '%Y%m%d') ) m JOIN T_BLDINF_TRAN a ON a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.UPT_VALUE > 0 AND a.CGM_DTM >= m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AND a.CGM_DTM < m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 3 HOUR ) v WHERE v.rn = 1 GROUP BY v.date2 ) p ON p.date2 = d.date2 ORDER BY d.date2

SELECT USER_UUID , WEEK_GU , CASE WHEN WEEK_GU = '0' THEN '월요일' WHEN WEEK_GU = '1' THEN '화요일' WHEN WEEK_GU = '2' THEN '수요일' WHEN WEEK_GU = '3' THEN '목요일' WHEN WEEK_GU = '4' THEN '금요일' WHEN WEEK_GU = '5' THEN '토요일' WHEN WEEK_GU = '6' THEN '일요일' END weekNm , ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(LOW,0)) / SUM(IFNULL(LOW,0) + IFNULL(NOR,0) + IFNULL(WARN,0) + IFNULL(DANR,0)) * 100,.1) lowAvg , ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(NOR,0)) / SUM(IFNULL(LOW,0) + IFNULL(NOR,0) + IFNULL(WARN,0) + IFNULL(DANR,0)) * 100,.1) norAvg , ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(WARN,0)) / SUM(IFNULL(LOW,0) + IFNULL(NOR,0) + IFNULL(WARN,0) + IFNULL(DANR,0)) * 100,.1) warnAvg , ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(DANR,0)) / SUM(IFNULL(LOW,0) + IFNULL(NOR,0) + IFNULL(WARN,0) + IFNULL(DANR,0)) * 100,.1) dangAvg , SUM(LOW + NOR +WARN + DANR) AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT a.USER_UUID ,WEEKDAY(DATE(CGM_DTM)) WEEK_GU , IFNULL(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE >= 0 AND UPT_VALUE < 70 THEN 1 end,0) LOW , IFNULL(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE >= 70 AND UPT_VALUE < 140 THEN 1 end,0) NOR , IFNULL(CASE WHEN UPT_VALUE >= 140 AND UPT_VALUE < 200 THEN 1 end,0) WARN , IFNULL(Case when UPT_VALUE >= 200 tHEN 1 end,0) DANR FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a where a.USER_UUID = #{userId} and DATE(a.cgm_dtm) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} and ifnull(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 ) K GROUP BY USER_UUID , WEEK_GU ORDER BY WEEK_GU ASC

/* [2026-08-21] 식후 = 끼니마다 [식사+2h, +3h) 첫 측정 — 정의·날짜 뼈대는 getDaylyBloodData 머리말 참조. ★두 화면이 쓴다 : ①일주일 차트(개요·통계) = avgPostMeal(날짜 수가 getWeeklyBloodData·getFastingBlood 와 같아야 요일이 맞음) ②통계 「일일 식후 혈당」(drawDailyMealBlood) = breakfast·lunch·dinner·date·max ⚠2026-08-21 처음 고칠 때 avgPostMeal 만 남겨 ②가 빈 차트가 됐다 — 끼니별 열을 반드시 유지할 것. 끼니 구분은 종전 기준 그대로 **식사 시각** 11시 전=아침 · 11~16시=점심 · 16시 이후=저녁(한 구간에 끼니가 둘이면 평균). avgPostMeal 은 구간 평균의 평균이 아니라 **그날 모든 끼니 값의 평균**(mealAvg·getDaylyBloodData 와 동일 값). */ SELECT d.date, d.date2, IFNULL(p.breakfast, 0) AS breakfast, IFNULL(p.lunch, 0) AS lunch, IFNULL(p.dinner, 0) AS dinner, IFNULL(p.avgpost, 0) AS avgPostMeal, CASE WHEN IFNULL(p.breakfast,0) + IFNULL(p.lunch,0) + IFNULL(p.dinner,0) > 0 THEN CEIL(GREATEST(IFNULL(p.breakfast,0), IFNULL(p.lunch,0), IFNULL(p.dinner,0)) / 100) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS max FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%c/%e') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date2, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 GROUP BY date, date2 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.date2, ROUND(AVG(v.UPT_VALUE), 1) AS avgpost, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN HOUR(v.meal_ts) < 11 THEN v.UPT_VALUE END), 1) AS breakfast, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN HOUR(v.meal_ts) >= 11 AND HOUR(v.meal_ts) < 16 THEN v.UPT_VALUE END), 1) AS lunch, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN HOUR(v.meal_ts) >= 16 THEN v.UPT_VALUE END), 1) AS dinner FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.meal_ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date2, m.meal_ts, a.UPT_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.meal_ts ORDER BY a.CGM_DTM ASC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(b.EAT_DATE, b.EAT_STIME), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS meal_ts FROM T_FOOD_TRAN b WHERE b.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND b.EAT_DATE >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')), '%Y%m%d') AND b.EAT_DATE <= DATE_FORMAT(DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')), '%Y%m%d') ) m JOIN T_BLDINF_TRAN a ON a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.UPT_VALUE > 0 AND a.CGM_DTM >= m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AND a.CGM_DTM < m.meal_ts + INTERVAL 3 HOUR ) v WHERE v.rn = 1 GROUP BY v.date2 ) p ON p.date2 = d.date2 ORDER BY d.date2

/* [2026-08-21] 공복 = 그날 03:00~05:00(미만) 평균 — 정의·날짜 뼈대는 getDaylyBloodData 머리말 참조. */ SELECT d.date, d.date2, IFNULL(f.avgfasting, 0) AS avgFasting FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%c/%e') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date2, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1), 0) AS avgBlood FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 GROUP BY date, date2 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.CGM_DTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date2, ROUND(AVG(a.UPT_VALUE), 1) AS avgfasting FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a WHERE a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(REPLACE(#{start},'T',' ')) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE(REPLACE(#{end},'T',' ')) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND IFNULL(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) >= '03:00:00' AND TIME(a.CGM_DTM) < '05:00:00' GROUP BY date2 ) f ON f.date2 = d.date2 ORDER BY d.date2

select USER_UUID , sum(holiday) as holiday , sum(holiday_cnt) as holiday_cnt , round(sum(holiday) / sum(holiday_cnt),.1) as holiday_avg , sum(weekday) as weekday , sum(weekday_cnt) as weekday_cnt , round(sum(weekday) / sum(weekday_cnt),.1) as weekday_avg from ( SELECT a.USER_UUID , CASE when WEEKDAY(DATE(a.cgm_dtm) ) in ('5','6') then a.UPT_VALUE end holiday , CASE when WEEKDAY(DATE(a.cgm_dtm) ) in ('5','6') then 1 end holiday_cnt , Case when WEEKDAY(DATE(a.cgm_dtm) ) in ('0','1','2','3','4') then a.UPT_VALUE end weekday , CASE when WEEKDAY(DATE(a.cgm_dtm) ) in ('0','1','2','3','4') then 1 end weekday_cnt FROM T_BLDINF_TRAN a where a.USER_UUID = #{userId} AND a.CGM_DTM >= DATE(#{start}) AND a.CGM_DTM < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{end}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and ifnull(a.UPT_VALUE,0) > 0 ) k group by USER_UUID
